description: The resource each payments contract version is current for under payments-runtime-profile-v15, as an authorization server's trusted configuration names it (Resource Contracts: the configuration states which contract version is current for an entry's resource). Version 2026-10-26 is current for the payments resource only; it is current for no other resource. It supersedes payments-contract-applicability-2026-10-26.json, which names 2026-10-24 and stays frozen as the historical configuration. It states currency only: whether a resource requires a reference, and the versions' Runtime states and retention, are outside this file.
